_doc: What the Melty page says and ships. One row = one fact. kind: text = wording, file = a path in this project that must exist, choice = a decision, id = a name Melty gave the listing (the mod reads these).
rows: Play Palworld as Steve: Minecraft survival, blocks, armor and weapons on the Palpagos Islands.
